name: Is a home value estimate the same as an appraisal?

mainEntity.name: Is a home value estimate the same as an appraisal?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, a home value estimate, often provided by a real estate agent via a Comparative Market Analysis (CMA), is different from a formal appraisal. An estimate offers a market-based opinion of value to help sellers price their homes. An appraisal, typically required by lenders, is a more detailed and legally recognized valuation performed by a licensed appraiser. While both assess value, an appraisal is a formal, independent report used for lending purposes, whereas an estimate guides listing prices in competitive markets like Boca Raton or Hollywood Beach.
acceptedAnswer.description: A home value estimate is an agent's market opinion, while an appraisal is a formal, legally recognized valuation by a licensed appraiser.
